infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Tri Fare Agoo uses your location to show nearby terminals and calculate your trip.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Tri Fare Agoo to use your location for fares and nearby terminals.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Tri Fare Agoo to attach a fare-board or receipt photo.
